basis: Tactical suggestions inferred from complete character cards, including signature moves; not official ratings or playtested rankings.

Commonwealth.plan: A Human combat core with renewable energy, healing and long-range pressure.

partners.reason: Squire and My Hero directly boost a Noble's melee and energy.
